SEO.title: Avanti Insieme Consulting | IT Solutions & Digital Transformation
SEO.description: Avanti Insieme Consulting delivers end-to-end IT services: web development, eCommerce, hardware installation, CMS, CRM, and AI solutions — growing with your business.
SEO.keywords: IT consulting, web development, eCommerce customization, CMS, CRM, AI solutions, hardware installation, digital transformation, Cornwall PEI

Header.title: Where Digital Meets Human
Header.paragraph: Avanti Insieme Consulting bridges the gap between hardware, software, and the people who use it — delivering end-to-end IT solutions that grow with your business, not just for the moment.

About.paragraph: At Avanti Insieme Consulting, 'Avanti Insieme' means 'Moving Forward Together' — and that's not just a name, it's our operating principle. We don't build one-off solutions and disappear. We become your long-term technology partner, invested in your success as much as our own.
listOfWhys: We believe your growth = our growth — our reputation is built on your results
We bridge digital, hardware, and human expertise under one roof — no handoffs, no gaps
Implementing automation wherever possible means more time for you to focus on your craft
We speak your language, not tech jargon — strategy and execution you can actually understand

Services.name: Website Development & Modernization
Services.text: From ground-up builds to full redesigns, we craft fast, accessible, and conversion-focused websites that reflect your brand and work flawlessly across every device.

Services.name: eCommerce Customization
Services.text: Sell more with a storefront built around your customers. We configure, extend, and customize eCommerce platforms so your products reach buyers with zero friction.

Services.name: Hardware Installation
Services.text: Computers, monitors, televisions, sound systems, and more — professionally installed, configured, and tested so your team hits the ground running from day one.

Services.name: CMS Installation & Customization
Services.text: Whether it's WordPress, Drupal, or another platform, we tailor your Content Management System to fit your workflow so publishing content is effortless.

Services.name: Customer Relationship Management
Services.text: Stop managing leads with sticky notes. We design and deploy CRMs that centralize your customer data, automate follow-ups, and help you close more business.

Services.name: Artificial Intelligence Solutions
Services.text: From intelligent chatbots to workflow automation and custom AI integrations, we implement practical AI that saves time, reduces errors, and scales with you.

Features.title: End-to-End Expertise
Features.text: From hardware setup to cloud software to AI — we handle every layer of your technology stack so you never have to juggle multiple vendors.

Features.title: Long-Term Partnership
Features.text: We don't disappear after launch. We invest in your growth, evolving your technology as your business scales.

Features.title: Automation-First Mindset
Features.text: We look for every opportunity to automate repetitive work — freeing your team to focus on what only humans can do.

Features.title: Human-Centered Approach
Features.text: No jargon, no confusion. We translate complex technology into plain language strategies you can actually understand and act on.
